ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across ~96% of the surface area; high-intensity pixels (white) are localized to specific scarring and distal tip barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity pigmentation (0-40 range) across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity pixel blobs (200-255 range) are clustered at the distal tips. Sparse white pixel mottling is visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 42 degrees and a pixel-depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sawtooth serration along both lobes; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 4 to 15 pixels, with higher peak density observed on the medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-sweeping convex curve terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast white pixels at both distal lobe tips corresponding to barnacle attachment. Small, isolated circular white spots (~5-10 pixel diameter) are present on the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions detected. Right lobe features three parallel lines (rake marks) angled at approx. 25 degrees. Left lobe displays multiple intersecting thin white lines of varying orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lateral tips; multiple linear rake marks and circular pitting scars distributed across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular, high-contrast additive pixel clusters at the distal extremities creating a non-linear, jagged boundary profile.
